verdict.rationale: Aleph is a SaaS FP&A platform that stores customer financial data, so letting customers choose a storage region is a fair question for it. The evidence pack covers encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, permissions, audit logs and data removal on cancellation, but nothing about selecting a storage region or data residency. Those are adjacent security controls and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
